tool.name: Slow Interval to Tabular converter
tool.command: ## This converter depends on slow_bed - the actual conversion is done by slow_bed_to_slow_tabular ## Sleep to simulate a slow conversion - allows testing race conditions sleep 2 && cp '$input1' '$output1'
tool.help: Slow converter for testing implicit conversion caching fix (chained conversion). Sleeps for 2 seconds before converting to simulate a slow conversion. This is the second step in the chain: interval -> slow_bed -> slow_tabular
